plan.notes: Source: City College of San Francisco official website (ccsf.edu), 'Political Science' degrees-certificates page — sample semester map ('Please note that the course maps provided are just an example to help you get started'). Single published pathway; term totals 16/15/15/16 = 62 (lower bounds), matching the sum of stated lower-bound totals (16-20/15-23/15-18/16-19). Credit ranges encode the source lower bound per collector convention; upper-bound total is 80. Degree typed as AA-T (transfer-focused CSU GE pattern with Transfer Options section); page does not explicitly label AA vs AA-T. GE slots are placeholders (e.g., 'CSU GE Area E', 'Additional CSU Transferable Units') as published.
